title: Close enough to warm the page
logline: Two weeks before the sequence stops. The glow close enough that the page's paper is warm-toned edge to edge; the trees drawn in ink on ochre; the man and the dog silhouettes now. Nothing seen. Everything lit.

panels.composition: The forest with the whole page warm — the paper itself toned ochre — the cedar trunks in dark ink against it, and a man and a small dog as black silhouettes walking between the trunks toward the warmth's source, which is off the page. No detail in the light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a forest of dark ink cedar trunks against a page toned entirely warm ochre with a man and a small three-legged dog as black silhouettes walking between the trunks toward an unseen light source off the page, no words
image.notes: Tone the whole paper. The source stays off the page.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The page warm edge to edge. Silhouettes.
